lrw.text: Colfenor, the last of the yew treefolk, is hosted by Gaddock Teeg at the Festival of Tales, and he hires Ashling through Teeg to reunite him with Rhys.

Teeg orders Brigid to bring Rhys back subdued, but Colfenor alters the message so that Brigid targets Ashling instead, foiling the plot, and he later admits he timed the attack to coincide with his rebirth.
When a greater elemental rekindles Ashling, Colfenor is set ablaze, using her patron elemental to end his own life, and the conflagration costs Teeg his life too.
Colfenor dies in Kinscaer and the bosk begins growing buds that burst open with faeries.

mor.text: Colfenor sends Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique to find Rhys with a message, declaring Rhys his final pupil and asking him to plant his seed cone in the Murmuring Bosk.
Colfenor burns to death as planned when Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental, promising to see Rhys again, and a day later a young treefolk rises at the Bosk.
